name: Rhythm
description: Focus blocks and movement breaks: a stand-up reminder that knows when you are at the keyboard, a pomodoro tied to a task, and quiet mode while you focus.

reminder_every_minutes.description: Minutes of continuous keyboard time before the stand-up reminder

away_reset_minutes.description: A gap this long with no attention counts as having moved, and the sitting streak starts over

snooze_minutes.description: How long Snooze on the stand-up reminder waits

quiet_hours.description: Local HH:MM-HH:MM window with no stand-up reminders; empty turns it off

defer_for_natural_pause_minutes.description: While an agent turn is running, wait up to this long for it to finish before reminding; 0 never waits

break_minutes.description: Length of the break after a focus block

long_break_every.description: Every Nth focus block is followed by the long break

focus_quiets_walnut.description: Turn on Walnut quiet mode while a focus block runs

mirror_macos_focus.description: Turn on Walnut quiet mode while a macOS Focus is on

macos_focus_shortcuts.description: Turn macOS Do Not Disturb on and off with each focus block, through two Shortcuts

reminder_every_minutes.label: Stand-up reminder (minutes)
reminder_every_minutes.help: Optional. Minutes at the keyboard before Rhythm asks you to stand up, 15 to 240.

away_reset_minutes.label: Away resets after (minutes)
away_reset_minutes.help: Optional. This long with no keyboard time counts as a break, and the count starts over.

snooze_minutes.label: Snooze (minutes)
snooze_minutes.help: Optional. How long Snooze on the stand-up reminder waits.

quiet_hours.label: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.help: Optional. No stand-up reminders inside this local window, as HH:MM-HH:MM. Leave empty for none.

defer_for_natural_pause_minutes.label: Wait for a turn to finish (minutes)
defer_for_natural_pause_minutes.help: Optional. While an agent is answering, wait up to this long so the reminder lands at a pause.

focus_minutes.label: Focus block (minutes)
focus_minutes.help: Optional. Length of one focus block.

break_minutes.label: Break (minutes)
break_minutes.help: Optional. Length of the break after a block.

long_break_minutes.label: Long break (minutes)
long_break_minutes.help: Optional. Length of the long break.

long_break_every.label: Long break every (blocks)
long_break_every.help: Optional. Every Nth block ends with the long break.

focus_quiets_walnut.label: Quiet Walnut while focusing
focus_quiets_walnut.help: Optional. Walnut quiet mode stays on for the length of each focus block.

mirror_macos_focus.label: Follow macOS Focus
mirror_macos_focus.help: Optional. Walnut goes quiet while a macOS Focus is on, and stand-up reminders wait.

macos_focus_shortcuts.label: Drive macOS Do Not Disturb
macos_focus_shortcuts.help: Optional. Each focus block turns Do Not Disturb on and off through two Shortcuts you add from the Rhythm app.
